// NOTE: :reference columns -> v.string() (Bubble text ids, not Convex document ids; re-key after data migration).
// NOTE: :enum columns -> v.string() (option-set member values are not rendered).
// NOTE: :api group tables are omitted.
import { defineSchema, defineTable } from "convex/server";
import { v } from "convex/values";

const addressValidator = v.object({
  latitude: v.optional(v.union(v.float64(), v.null())),
  lines: v.optional(v.union(v.array(v.string()), v.null())),
  seen: v.optional(v.union(v.float64(), v.null())),
  street: v.optional(v.union(v.string(), v.null())),
  verified: v.optional(v.union(v.boolean(), v.null())),
});
const bValidator = v.object({
  a: v.optional(v.union(v.any(), v.null())),
  blob: v.optional(v.union(v.any(), v.null())),
});
const aValidator = v.object({
  at: v.optional(v.union(v.string(), v.null())),
  b: v.optional(v.union(bValidator, v.null())),
});
const nodeValidator = v.object({
  children: v.optional(v.union(v.array(v.any()), v.null())),
  label: v.optional(v.union(v.string(), v.null())),
});

export default defineSchema({
  shipment: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
    createdDate: v.float64(),
    modifiedDate: v.float64(),
    createdBy: v.string(), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)
    slug: v.string(),
    address: addressValidator,
    blank: v.any(),
    invalid: v.any(),
    invalidList: v.any(),
    missing: v.any(),
    nowhere: v.any(),
    pings: aValidator,
    tree: nodeValidator,
  }),

  user: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
    createdDate: v.float64(),
    modifiedDate: v.float64(),
    createdBy: v.string(), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)
    slug: v.string(),
    email: v.string(),
  }),
});
